required_inputs: Frozen public PWR/SB-LOCA manifest and trajectory split.
One matched baseline and one bounded candidate configuration.
A manifest declaring labels, trajectory IDs, counts, channel units, sampling rate, and prediction horizon.
Trajectory- and scenario-level train, validation, and held-out partition identities.
Target-domain labels confirming every retained record is a PWR SB-LOCA transient with a declared break-extent unit, sampling rate, and horizon.
A feature schema containing every required physics-derived residual or conservation feature column with units.
Frozen preprocessing, feature, target, intended-use, calibration, in-distribution, and out-of-distribution specifications.
incompatible_conditions: The frozen manifest, labels, trajectory identities, counts, units, sampling rate, or horizon are missing or unresolved.
Any trajectory or scenario identifier overlaps train, validation, and held-out partitions.
Any retained record has an ambiguous PWR SB-LOCA label, break-extent unit, sampling rate, or horizon.
Any required physics-derived residual or conservation feature column is missing or lacks a unit.
Label provenance, target definition, preprocessing provenance, calibration definition, or distribution boundary is unavailable.
The intended use requires plant operation, deployment, protection credit, or a safety conclusion.
Qualified specialist review is unavailable for any nuclear operational or safety interpretation.

assumptions: The observational unit is a simulated SB-LOCA trajectory; correlated windows and descendants remain in the same partition.
The data are public simulated PWR accident data, not plant observations or experimental measurements.
Break-extent labels, channel units, sampling, horizon, missingness, and preprocessing provenance are declared before fitting.
The matched baseline and candidate use identical frozen partitions, temporal backbone, seed, horizon, preprocessing, and resource accounting.
Physics-derived features are unit-labelled; any physical constraint not directly verified is treated as approximate or unchecked.
Exchangeability is limited to the declared simulated target-domain strata, and transfer beyond them remains a hypothesis.
baselines: Matched temporal regression on the identical frozen split and resource ceiling.
controls: Use the identical frozen split, temporal backbone, seed, horizon, and inherited resource ceiling for the baseline and candidate.
Fit preprocessing only on the training partition and preserve its fitted-state provenance for both comparisons.
Keep correlated trajectories, scenarios, and future information out of opposing partitions.
procedure_outline: Read the manifest, labels, sampling rate, horizon, and partition identities before any fit; stop on a failed precondition.
Only after every preflight passes, fit one matched baseline and one bounded candidate within the inherited ceilings.
Score every bound metric once and record a closed Go, Stop, or Pivot disposition without deployment or safety claims.
uncertainty_handling: Report the uncertainty metric on the untouched held-out split and compare behavior across declared target-domain strata.
Separate sampling, label, measurement, model, optimization, and distribution-shift uncertainty instead of collapsing them into one score.
Do not treat correlated windows or augmented samples as independent replicates, and preserve unfavorable or unstable results.
validation_checks: Verify the manifest, split, target-domain, and physics-feature preconditions read-only before any fit.
Verify manifest completeness, zero identifier overlap, identical controls, numeric resource logs, and no operational extrapolation.
Audit split independence and preprocessing isolation before interpreting any metric.
Recompute only the bound metrics across fixed onset-window and horizon strata without adding fits.
Treat closed-bundle validation as deterministic offline contract evidence, not model performance, generalization, transfer, deployment, or safety evidence.
failure_modes: Trajectory, scenario, temporal, preprocessing, label, or future-information leakage can invalidate every held-out metric.
Missing or ambiguous labels, units, horizons, or physics-feature columns can invalidate the selected claims.
Simulator shift, configuration shift, class imbalance, missing-not-at-random data, or shortcut learning can invalidate target-domain interpretation.
Miscalibration, OOD overconfidence, unstable optimization, or failed hybrid constraints can invalidate uncertainty or predictive claims.
Resource-ceiling overruns, calibration-set reuse, or discarded negative results can invalidate the bounded comparison.
safety_boundaries: This card is advisory only; it does not execute the route, process data, train or run a model, allocate compute, or authorize deployment.
Use only public simulated data; do not infer plant validity, operational safety, licensing acceptance, protection credit, or empirical success.
Preserve deterministic protections, interlocks, conservative limits, defense in depth, human authority, and shutdown authority.
Require qualified data, ML, nuclear-domain, VVUQ, security, human-factors, and safety review before any consequential use.
Offline contract validity does not establish method effectiveness, simulation validity, target-domain transfer, operational qualification, or nuclear safety.
